text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 大家好,欢迎收听《Real Easy English》。
zh_hant: 大家好,歡迎收聽《Real Easy English》。

text: In this podcast,
we have real conversations in easy English
zh: 我们用简单的英语进行真实对话,
zh_hant: 我們用簡單的英語進行真實對話,

text: to help you learn.
I'm Neil.
And I'm Beth.
Did you know you can watch a video of this podcast on our website?
zh: 你知道吗,你可以在我们的网站上看这期播客的视频。
zh_hant: 你知道嗎,你可以在我們的網站上看這期播客的影片。

text: Go to bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi Beth, how are you today?
I'm very good, thank you.
Neil, how are you?
I'm very good.
What are we talking about?
Well, today we are talking about waste .
zh: 嗯,今天我们要聊聊“垃圾/废弃物(waste)”。
zh_hant: 嗯,今天我們要聊聊“垃圾/廢棄物(waste)”。

text: So that's what we call things
that we don't want any more, like rubbish
zh: 那些我们不再想要的东西,比如垃圾,
zh_hant: 那些我們不再想要的東西,比如垃圾,

text: or things that we've used,
zh: 或者我们已经用过的东西,
zh_hant: 或者我們已經用過的東西,

text: and we now don't need them.
So, for example,
after I've eaten some crisps as a snack,
zh: 比如我吃完薯片当零食之后,
zh_hant: 比如我吃完薯片當零食之後,

text: the, the packet is rubbish, it's waste .
zh: 那个包装袋就是垃圾,就是waste。
zh_hant: 那個包裝袋就是垃圾,就是waste。

text: Are you good at dealing with waste ?
Yeah,
I do what I'm supposed to do.
So we have a separate bin for different things.
zh: 我们家有不同的垃圾桶,用来分类。
zh_hant: 我們家有不同的垃圾桶,用來分類。

text: For plastic and for glass and for paper and for food.
zh: 塑料、玻璃、纸张和食物各有一个。
zh_hant: 塑膠、玻璃、紙張和食物各有一個。

text: Yeah.
When I was a kid, everything went in the same bin.
zh: 我小时候,所有垃圾都扔在同一个桶里。
zh_hant: 我小時候,所有垃圾都扔在同一個桶裡。

text: Really?
Yeah.
And now that seems really crazy
zh: 现在想想那真是太疯狂了,
zh_hant: 現在想想那真是太瘋狂了,

text: and really bad.
Yeah.
So I think we are better now
zh: 所以我觉得我们现在在处理垃圾方面
zh_hant: 所以我覺得我們現在在處理垃圾方面

text: at dealing with waste ,
but probably there's more things we could do.
zh: 但可能还有更多可以改进的地方。
zh_hant: 但可能還有更多可以改進的地方。

text: Yeah, I would think so.
Yeah.
Something that I do as well in, is when I'm in a supermarket,
zh: 我自己也有个做法,就是在超市里,
zh_hant: 我自己也有個做法,就是在超市裡,

text: I try to not buy fruit and veg that's wrapped in plastic.
zh: 我尽量不买用塑料包装的水果和蔬菜。
zh_hant: 我儘量不買用塑膠包裝的水果和蔬菜。

text: I'll always try and buy
the individual products
like apples on their own.
Or, you know, a courgette.
zh: 或者,比如说,一根西葫芦。
zh_hant: 或者,比如說,一根西葫蘆。

text: You don't need a courgette that's wrapped in plastic.
zh: 你不需要买用塑料包起来的西葫芦。
zh_hant: 你不需要買用塑膠包起來的西葫蘆。

text: Well, that's a good idea,
but sometimes it's actually quite difficult to find things
zh: 但有时候真的很难找到
zh_hant: 但有時候真的很難找到

text: that aren't covered in plastic
zh: 没有用塑料包装的东西,
zh_hant: 沒有用塑膠包裝的東西,

text: because we rely on plastic so much.
zh: 因为我们太依赖塑料了。
zh_hant: 因為我們太依賴塑膠了。

text: Yeah, I know that is true.
You know what people do these days,
zh: 你知道现在人们会做一件很棒的事吗,
zh_hant: 你知道現在人們會做一件很棒的事嗎,

text: which is great that they didn't used to do.
zh: 以前他们可不会这样做。
zh_hant: 以前他們可不會這樣做。

text: Carry reusable water bottles.
zh: 随身携带可重复使用的水壶。
zh_hant: 隨身攜帶可重複使用的水壺。

text: That's true.
Almost everybody carries a bottle.
zh: 几乎每个人都随身带着水壶。
zh_hant: 幾乎每個人都隨身帶著水壺。

text: And just a few years ago,
people bought plastic bottles of, of water all the time.
zh: 人们还经常买瓶装水喝。
zh_hant: 人們還經常買瓶裝水喝。

text: Yeah, I remember when I was teaching
zh: 是啊,我记得我以前教书的时候,
zh_hant: 是啊,我記得我以前教書的時候,

text: in a classroom and I'd sometimes have students.
zh: 在课堂上,有时会有学生。
zh_hant: 在課堂上,有時會有學生。

text: They would come to London from all over the world, and every day they would go to a supermarket and buy a plastic bottle.
zh: 他们从世界各地来到伦敦,每天都会去超市买一瓶塑料瓶装水。
zh_hant: 他們從世界各地來到倫敦,每天都會去超市買一瓶塑膠瓶裝水。

text: And I used to, I used to say sometimes, you know 'why, buy a reusable one'
zh: 我那时候常跟他们说,‘为什么不买个可重复使用的水壶呢’,
zh_hant: 我那時候常跟他們說,‘為什麼不買個可重複使用的水壺呢’,

text: and then you're not using this plastic all the time.
zh: 那样你就不用一直用这种塑料瓶了。
zh_hant: 那樣你就不用一直用這種塑膠瓶了。

text: Yeah.
We have a word for that, don't we?
zh: 我们有个专门的词来形容这种情况,对吧?
zh_hant: 我們有個專門的詞來形容這種情況,對吧?

text: Single-use plastic .
Yeah.
So we have to try and avoid single-use plastics .
zh: 所以我们得尽量避免使用一次性塑料。
zh_hant: 所以我們得儘量避免使用一次性塑膠。

text: What about water?
So water waste .
I really like having a bath just to relax,
but sometimes I feel really guilty about it because
zh: 但有时候我会觉得挺内疚的,因为
zh_hant: 但有時候我會覺得挺內疚的,因為

text: it's using up quite a lot of water.
Yeah, I prefer showers, which is good because
zh: 嗯,我更喜欢淋浴,这样挺好的,因为
zh_hant: 嗯,我更喜歡淋浴,這樣挺好的,因為

text: they use less water.
I should probably have fewer baths.
zh: 我可能应该少泡几次澡。
zh_hant: 我可能應該少泡幾次澡。

text: I mean, I maybe have one a week,
zh: 我是说,我大概一周泡一次,
zh_hant: 我是說,我大概一週泡一次,

text: so...
I mean, I shower too, of course.
But maybe I could have a bath less often.
zh: 但也许我可以减少泡澡的次数,
zh_hant: 但也許我可以減少泡澡的次數,

text: Find other ways of relaxing which are less wasteful.
zh: 找些别的、更节约资源的放松方式。
zh_hant: 找些別的、更節約資源的放鬆方式。

text: What about you?
Anything you want to cut back on ?
zh: 有什么是你想要减少使用的吗?
zh_hant: 有什麼是你想要減少使用的嗎?

text: Yeah, I think,
we talked about single-use plastic .
zh: 我们刚才聊到一次性塑料。
zh_hant: 我們剛才聊到一次性塑膠。

text: You know, clingfilm,
the very thin, like, sheet,
sheets of plastic
that you wrap food in.
Yeah.
I always feel bad when I use that stuff,
zh: 我每次用那个都觉得挺内疚的,
zh_hant: 我每次用那個都覺得挺內疚的,

text: but it's also really convenient and does its job well
zh: 但它确实很方便,也很好用,
zh_hant: 但它確實很方便,也很好用,

text: keeping a sandwich together or whatever.
zh: 比如用来包三明治之类的,效果很好。
zh_hant: 比如用來包三明治之類的,效果很好。

text: But I don't like it,
so I want to cut down on my use of clingfilm.
zh: 所以我想减少使用保鲜膜。
zh_hant: 所以我想減少使用保鮮膜。

text: We had single-use plastics .
zh: 我们提到了“一次性塑料(single-use plastics)”。
zh_hant: 我們提到了“一次性塑膠(single-use plastics)”。

text: These are plastic materials that we use once and then throw away.
zh: 这是指我们只用一次就丢掉的塑料制品。
zh_hant: 這是指我們只用一次就丟掉的塑膠製品。

text: So for example, food wrappers and shopping bags.
zh: 比如食品包装袋和购物袋。
zh_hant: 比如食品包裝袋和購物袋。

text: We heard recycle which means to collect rubbish
zh: 我们听到了“回收(recycle)”这个词,意思是收集垃圾,
zh_hant: 我們聽到了“回收(recycle)”這個詞,意思是收集垃圾,

text: in order to make materials
that can be used again.
We can also describe something as recyclable .
zh: 我们也可以说某样东西是“可回收的(recyclable)”。
zh_hant: 我們也可以說某樣東西是“可回收的(recyclable)”。

text: It means it can be recycled .
zh: 意思是它可以被回收利用,
zh_hant: 意思是它可以被回收利用,

text: It can be used again.
And we heard some
common phrasal verbs
that we use
when talking about the environment.
So we had to rely on which means need something
zh: 我们听到了“rely on”,意思是需要某样东西
zh_hant: 我們聽到了“rely on”,意思是需要某樣東西

text: in order to function.
For example, we rely on plastic a lot in our daily lives.
zh: 比如说,我们日常生活中很依赖塑料。
zh_hant: 比如說,我們日常生活中很依賴塑膠。

text: We can also say cut down on which means
zh: 我们还可以说“cut down on”,意思是
zh_hant: 我們還可以說“cut down on”,意思是

text: to reduce something.
And we also hear
cut back on .
So for example I want to cut back on s ingle-use plastic.
zh: 比如说,我想减少一次性塑料的使用。
zh_hant: 比如說,我想減少一次性塑膠的使用。

text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 这就是本期《Real Easy English》的全部内容。
zh_hant: 這就是本期《Real Easy English》的全部內容。

text: If you want to learn more phrasal verbs about the environment,
zh: 如果你想学习更多关于环境话题的动词短语,
zh_hant: 如果你想學習更多關於環境話題的動詞短語,

text: then Georgie has made a whole video on this.
zh: Georgie做了一整期视频来讲解这个主题。
zh_hant: Georgie做了一整期影片來講解這個主題。

text: You'll find the link in the notes below.
zh: 你可以在下方的说明栏找到链接。
zh_hant: 你可以在下方的說明欄找到連結。

text: And next time on Real Easy English, we'll be talking about confidence.
zh: 下一期《Real Easy English》,我们将聊聊“自信”这个话题。
zh_hant: 下一期《Real Easy English》,我們將聊聊“自信”這個話題。

text: See you then.
Bye.
